rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing medical education (types not specified in Rule 24)
rules.audit_note: Annual renewal form: certify under penalty of perjury that CME was met; the Board may randomly require proof before renewal. Keep CME records at least three years from the end of the reporting period.

topics.who: All PAs: prescribing of opioids and benzodiazepines, every year, within the 20 hours
PAs authorized to prescribe Schedule II hydrocodone combination products; how often is not stated in the rule

rules.notes: Extensions possible for illness, military service, missionary work, foreign residence or other extenuating circumstances. Rule 24 does not mention NCCPA certification as a CME substitute; renewal month not stated in the rule.
rules.legal_basis: Arkansas State Medical Board Rule No. 24, Section 9; Ark. Code Ann. §17-105-105
